messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm full-volume commitment for 2027 onwards
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. You wrote that you prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments. Our attached term sheets offer exactly that: our full 23400 pcs per year, bound for 24 or 36 months. This gives you a secure base for your capacity planning.

Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010), below your price. The forecast for part:340010 increased by 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

What is the earliest lead time you can confirm for the full volume?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm full-volume commitment for 2027 onwards
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We note your increased volume and longer commitment, allowing a revised offer of €31.70 for 23,400 units over 24 months. Our offer is a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. In response to your question, 56 days is the earliest lead time we can confirm for the full volume. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – revised packages for a firm 24/36-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for confirming the lead time. We have moved toward you in the attached term sheets. Each binds our full 23400 pcs per year for 24 or 36 months, the firm, long-term commitment you said you prioritise. One package accepts your 56-day lead time. The other two offer a 42-day lead time for a 24- or 36-month term, in case you can free capacity for a longer commitment.

As discussed at our annual review (doc:20260310-70410-M1), changes of this size go to your pricing committee.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – revised packages for a firm 24/36-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your revised offer and your acceptance of our 56-day lead time.

In response, we adjust our price to €31.50 per unit for a volume of 23400 pcs per year over a contract term of 24 months. Lieferzeit is 56 days. Please note that this is our letztes Angebot. Please decide. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Additionally, please provide the document doc:20260310-70410-M1 you referenced, as we require the data to verify your claim.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – revised packages for a firm 24/36-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
